description: Calculate a deterministic personal natal chart or national mundane chart using the high-precision astronomical ephemeris calculation engine. Corresponds to /chart and /mundane slash commands. Supports EITHER a country name (e.g. 'India', 'USA', 'France') for a national chart OR personal birth details ('date', 'time', 'city'). Automatically provides dynamic 'chart_ui_url', calculates planetary placements, active Dasha cycle, grounded knowledge-base insights, and an ERUX interactive UI link. CRITICAL FOR AI: When calculate_chart is called, present the key placements cleanly and provide a direct, prominent link inviting the user to view their interactive chart wheel on ERUX using 'chart_ui_url' (e.g. [✨ Open Your Interactive Chart Wheel on ERUX](chart_ui_url)).
